Design specification and basis :  1.Design requirements and related information provided by owners and brand owners。 2.The relevant information provided by each professional in cooperation with the manufacturer。  II. Material description: 1. Material requirements for door head: The exterior facade material shall be silver gray stainless steel finish according to the design requirements of the drawingsDoor head: All use illuminated logos, and construction is strictly in accordance with the drawings.Wall: Newly constructed walls, unless otherwise specified, are all 100# light steel joist partitions. Main construction materials: silver gray matte painted stainless steel plate Lock latch flooring, flame retardant board, white paint board, white artificial stone, silver gray matte paint  III .Special notes:  In order to cater forInsta360's nationwide identity promotion and maintain the same design style, the construction party, supporting units and manufacturers are requested to carefully review the drawings before proceeding with the construction. For any problems not specified in this design set, your company or the project leader of the construction unit shall communicate with our company and we will respond as soon as possible. Thank you for cooperation! At the same time, please cooperate with us in terms of the following matters: -   Before and during the construction, the construction party must first review the drawings and prepare detailed construction and schedule plans. In case of any problems, please contact the designer immediately to explain the situation in detail. Any inconsistency between the site conditions and drawings, and relevant issues during the construction shall be submitted to the design team for confirmation before relevant construction processes are implemented, issues affecting the design shall be communicated with the design team for confirmation before the construction. It is not allowed to modify the plan or carry out construction without authorization; -   The construction party is required to print the construction drawings according to the size of the paper received, and must be constructed according to the drawings. All dimensions are not allowed to be measured directly in the drawing, and all dimensions shall be subject to the data marked in the drawing. -   After receiving the full set of drawings, please call our designer promptly to confirm the start date and demolition date, so that our supervisors can make their schedule accordingly and ensure timely and effective delivery of the works. -   After the demolition, the construction party shall measure the site dimensions and record the problem dimensions. Carefully review the construction drawings, and make a trial setout on the site. -   Our supervisors arrive at the site to confirm that the setting out is correct, and then carry out next step of construction; Confirm the component order at the same time. -   Please call the designer after the store is opened, and our company will arrange the completion acceptance of the store.  IV .Construction Note:  Design elevation and dimensions: 1. The elevations noted in the drawing are set with the elevation of ± 0.00. 2. All dimensions indicated in the construction drawing are in "mm", other than elevations, which are in "m". 3. The dimensions indicated in this construction drawing shall be subject to the dimensions indicated on the drawing, and shall not be measured and calculated according to the scale of the drawing. Fire protection design: 1. The fire protection rating of all fire doors shall be selected according to the original building design grade. See the materials shown in the elevation for the decorative surface. 2. Please see the table of materials for details of the fire rating of interior decoration materials of the building. Roofing materials shall be Class A non-combustible materials, and the floor and wall materials shall be Class B1 flame-retardant materials. 3. All base course materials shall meet the fire prevention and other requirements of special acceptance of fire control and quality inspection departments. 4. All walkway partition walls shall be built with floor slab (beam) bottom, transverse (vertical) holes and gaps on floor slab and partition wall, and seams and pipeline crossings shall be sealed and filled with non-combustible materials within the same fire resistance limit. Ceiling: 1.If the hanging bars in the ceiling exceed 1.5 meters, reverse support is required. If they exceed 2 meters, a transition layer (transition layer: use 40mm * 40mm * 3mm (minimum standard) angle iron for spacing) is required 800mm * 800mm grid leveling, with vertical angle iron spacing of 1600mm * 1600mm); 2.The ceiling keel must have sufficient mechanical strength (the main keel should be made of materials above 60, and the auxiliary keel should be made of materials above 50; the spacing between the suspension rods should be ≤ 800mm, the spacing between the main keel should be ≤ 800mm, and the spacing between the auxiliary keels should be ≤ 350mm; the thickness of the main keel should be ≥ 1.2mm, the thickness of the auxiliary keel should be ≥ 0.6mm, and the diameter of the suspension rods should be ≥ 10mm; a maintenance hole must be reserved below the ceiling equipment, with a size of not less than 600mm × 600mm, and the surrounding keel or corner iron ring should be firmly fixed, and hanging pieces should be installed; the walls of the ceiling and adjacent tenants in the public area should be sealed to the top, and the through wall holes should be closed. The finished surface height of the ceiling should be ≥ 3 meters; gypsum board installed on light steel keel can be Use of decoration materials. Partition walls: 1. Unless otherwise specified, the light steel keel partition walls are made of 75 or 100 series keel; see the wall legend and detailed drawings. 2. Weigh light steel keel frame according to the board wall, light steel keel spacing ≤ 400MM, parts above and below should be fixed firmly. Then set the auxiliary keel and put on the keel connector. Inorganic coating wall finish: 1. For single-layer 12mm thick paper gypsum board, the interface of gypsum board must be on the keel with a gap of ±3MM, and the lines shall be strictly straight; 2. The gypsum board screws shall be rustproof with a spacing of < 250-300mm. The screws shall be tightened and the gypsum board shall not be damaged. All wood should be painted with fireproof paint. 3. The joint shall be leveled with special joint bandage, special glue and embedded with special putty. 4.All exposed iron parts shall be coated with red primer for rust prevention, and one primer and two top coats shall be applied in case of inorganic coating. Aluminum plate wall finish: 1. Inspect the wall quality, clean and reinforce. 2. According to the drawing, the stainless steel plate shall be separated and typeset in combination with the actual size on site. 3. Snap lines on the wall, embed the fixings and galvanized steel and metal fixings (for concrete walls, they can be directly fixed on the wall, and for light block partition walls, they can be fixed to the ceiling and floor or fixed on the ring beam). All structural fixings need to be galvanized to prevent corrosion. 4. Stainless steel finish, grooving and folding to ensure surface flatness and neat gap. The purchased materials and accessories can be used only after being checked and confirmed that they are qualified.  V.Other notes:  1. The design of this project shall beimplemented according to current regulations and construction regulations of China. In case of any conflict between this document and the regulations, please contact the designer. 2. The construction party must study and verify all dimensions and be responsible for them; in the event of any changes, the designer shall be promptly notified. 3. All selected materials shall be subject to the material samples; the construction party shall provide corresponding material samples, and only when they are approved by the designer and the owner could the construction work be carried out. 4. Relevant disciplines for water, electricity, wind and other relevant electromechanical works shall closely coordinate with each other during the construction. In case of any unclarity or inconsistency, please promptly contact the designer to resolve the issue together. 5. All ports on the decorative surface shall be factory made, and their colors shall be close to those of the finish materials unless otherwise specified. if any unclarity or inconsistency is found, contact the design party in time to jointly resolve it. 6. The construction party shall be responsible for the safety of finish base, large lamps, furniture, fixtures and other fixtures within the construction; for important parts, the corresponding embedding, reinforcement and installation drawings shall be provided to the designer for confirmation, to ensure safety. 7. Each supplier shall verify the size on the site to ensure that the installation is appropriate. If there is any doubt, the designer shall be promptly notified. 8. All construction processes and practices not mentioned in the design drawings shall be performed in accordance with GB50210-2001, Code for Construction Quality Acceptance of Building Decoration. 9. Please refer to the relevant drawings for the installation of water, electricity and air.  VI.Construction Requirements:  The construction party shall strictly comply with relevant laws and regulations regarding construction projects as well as the quality acceptance specifications regarding the building decoration projects. It is strictly forbidden to work without a permit, and the measures regarding the configuration of temporary electricity usage, noise, dust, odor, lighting, and public disturbance prevention during construction shall comply with relevant construction regulations. The person responsible for managing on-site workers of the construction party shall have relevant knowledge and professional capability in construction process, design, construction drawings, construction engineering regulations and specifications, communication and coordination.  Ground (floor tiles finish): 1. The ground shall be paved in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 2. Base leveling: According to the design elevation of the floor, use 1: 3 dry hard cement mortar leveling, pull horizontal through line at the reference point for laying. Before paving and plastering the dry and hard cement mortar on the base course, the plain cement slurry shall be evenly plastered on the surface of the base course to increase the adhesion between the base course and the leveling course. 3. Floor tile laying, maintenance. Lamps, circuit: 1. Electrical installation and construction personnel shall be certified. 2. The lamps shall be installed in strict accordance with the direction marked on the drawing line. 3. The pipeline route, elevation and other positions shall be determined according to the position of lamps, sockets and distribution box in drawing. When wiring the power line, the cross section of the conductor used shall meet the maximum output power of the electrical equipment. The main power distribution box shall be placed in the warehouse as far as possible, and no rocker switch shall be set in the mall area. 4. Adjust the best illumination angle of lamps in time after the store is opened.

PE线必须用绿/黄导线或标识；平面图中所有回路均按回路单独穿管，不同支路 不应共管敷设。各回路N、PE线均从箱内引出。 6. 配电线路不得穿越通风管道内腔或直接敷设在通风管道外壁上，穿金属导管保护 的配电线路可紧贴通风管道外壁敷设。配电线路敷设在有可燃物的闷顶、吊顶内时， 应采取穿金属导管、采用封闭式金属槽盒等防火保护措施。 7. 所有插座均采用安全型插座，暗装，普通插座底边距地0.3m，排气扇插座吸顶 安装，灯具开关均选用10A,250V跷板开关，底边距地1.4m。 8. 低压普通插座回路装设接地故障保护，选用一般型（无延时）的剩余电流保护装 置，其额定剩余动作电流不超过30mA。 9. 所有开关、插座和照明器具靠近可燃物安装时，应采取隔热、散热等保护措施。 10. 建筑内部的配电箱、控制面板、接线盒、开关、插座等不应直接安装在低于B1 级的装修材料上；用于顶棚和墙面装修的木质类板材，当内部含有电器、电线、线 管（槽）等物体时，应采用不低于B1级的材料。 11. 照明灯具及电气设备、线路的高温部位，当靠近非A级装修材料或构件时，应采 取隔热、散热等防火保护措施，与窗帘、帷幕、幕布、软包等装修材料的距离不应 小于500mm；灯饰应采用不低于B1级的材料。 12. 天花上所有强电线路必须设计使用镀锌线管，线管与线管用金属铁盒连接，金 属软管与盖板用锁头连接软长度不得超过 50CM;金属线管与线管用之间必须安装跨 接地线（必须采用2.5平方毫米铜线接地夹跨接）或焊接地线。不允许有任何外露布 线（延伸电线等）;严禁使用PVC线管。 12. 本工程照明插座平面图根据装修条件设计，所有设备的选型和位置以装修图为 准。  Architectural Electrical Design Description  FC WC CC SCE 4 3 2 1 MR JDG 4 3 2 1   2   3   3   4   5   6   7   8 1.0   15   15   15   20   20   25   25   25 1.5   20   20   20   20   25   25   32   32 2.5   20   20   20   20   25   25   32   32 4.0   20   20   20   25   25   32   32   32 6.0   20   25   25   25   32   32   32   40 10.0   25   32   32   32   32   40   40  I. Project Overview This project is Insta360-1Utama Shopping Center Koisk Store. It is mainly used as reception, sales and exhibition. II. Scope of Design The content of this design is the socket and lighting distribution design within the decoration area, and other non decoration areas are not within the scope of this design. III. Power Distribution System 1. Power load grade: The power consumption and reserved power load grade of sockets within the decoration scope is Grade III; the power supply is led from the normal power distribution box between floors. Details will be determined after field survey. 2. Selection of cables and wires: (1) In the low-voltage 220/380V power supply circuit, the rated voltage of power cable: 0.6/1kV; the rated voltage of wire: 450/750V; (2) the rated voltage of control cable: 300/500V; (3) The general distribution wire and cable shall be of low-smoke, halogen-free flame retardant type. The combustion performance class is B1, the combustion droplet/particle class is d1, and the smoke toxicity class is t1 respectively. 3. Lighting control: The power supply for the storefront logo and checkout counter is controlled by a time module, while other lighting, indoor logos, etc. are centrally controlled by a one key closing switch on the distribution box. 4. The energy efficiency level of motors, AC contactors and lighting products in this project shall be higher than the energy efficiency limit value or the requirements of Grade 3 energy efficiency. Tubes, pipelines and fittings with good corrosion resistance, aging resistance and durability shall be used at the same time. 5. PE line must be marked with green/yellow conductor; all circuits in the plan view shall be separately routed according to the circuit, and different branches shall not be laid together. The N and PE lines of each loop are led out from the box. 6. Distribution lines shall not pass through the inner cavity of ventilation duct or be laid directly on the outer wall of ventilation duct. Distribution lines protected by metal conduit can be laid closely to the outer wall of ventilation duct. When the distribution line is laid in the covered roof or suspended ceiling with combustible substances, fire protection measures should be taken, such as running through metal conduit and adopting enclosed metal tank box. 7. All sockets should be of safe type and mounted in a concealed manner. Bottom edge of common socket shall be 0.3m from the ground. The exhaust fan socket shall be installed at the top, and the lamp switch shall be 10A and 250V small plate switch, and the bottom edge shall be 1.4m from the ground. 8. The circuit of low-voltage common socket should support earth fault protection function. The residual current protection device of general type (without delay) shall be selected, and its rated residual operating current shall not exceed 30mA. 9. When all switches, sockets, and lighting fixtures are installed near combustible materials, protective measures such as insulation and heat dissipation should be taken. 10. Distribution boxes, control panels, junction boxes, switches and sockets inside the building shall not be installed directly on decoration materials lower than Class B1; for wood panels used for ceiling and wall decoration, when the interior contains electrical appliances, wires, conduits (slots) and other objects, materials not lower than B1 should be used. 11. When high temperature parts of lighting fixtures, electrical equipment, and circuits are close to non Class A decoration materials or components, fire protection measures such as insulation and heat dissipation should be taken, and the distance from decoration materials such as curtains, curtains, curtains, and soft bags should not be less than 500mm; Lighting fixtures should use materials not lower than B1 level. 12. All strong electrical lines on the ceiling must be designed to use galvanized conduit, which is connected to each other with metal iron boxes. The flexible length of the metal hose connected to the cover plate with a lock should not exceed 50cm; A grounding wire (using a 2.5mm square copper wire grounding clamp) or a welded grounding wire must be installed between the metal conduit and the conduit. No exposed wiring (such as extension wires) is allowed; Strictly prohibit the use of PVC conduit. 12. The socket plan of this project is designed according to the decoration conditions. Model selection and location of all equipment shall be subject to the decoration drawing. 13. The lighting socket plan of this project is designed according to the decoration conditions, and the selection and location of all equipment are subject to the decoration plan.  附：线缆敷设标注 Attached: Descriptions of cable laying  线缆敷设方式标注 Descriptions of cable laying mode 序号 No.   名   称 Name 代号 Code 线缆敷设方式标注 Descriptions of cable laying mode 序号 No.   名   称 Name 代号 Code  穿套接紧定式钢管敷设（JDG） Laid by running through JDG pipe (JDG) 金属槽盒敷设 Laid by metal slot 吊顶内敷设 Laid inside ceiling 暗敷设在顶板内 Concealed inside the top plate 暗敷设在顶板内 Concealed inside wall 暗敷设在地板或地面下 Concealed below floor or ground  附：常用导线穿管表 Attached: List of Common Conductor Casings  BYJ线芯 截面 Section of BYJ wire core （mm 2 ） 电线管（JDG）/PVC管（PC）管内导线根数 Wire tube (JDG)/PVC pipe (PC) Qty. of conductors inside the pipe
